construction.initial_centers_decoder: In normalized coordinates B*lattice_word-boundary_mark.point, using the exact rational basis. Boundary marks are actual canonical source-owner vertices, edge midpoints or face centroids with retained vertex indices.
construction.physical_operation: Cut a finite set of complete owners around one source-owner boundary mark. Retain a realized directed facet separator for every pair and restore all24 common host walls. Any following contact return uses only facets exposed on the actual preceding complete packing. Owner frames remain identity.
construction.native_decoder: Multiply the exact rational normalized centers by(3sqrt2/4)*(100000001/100000000), round to binary64 and retain identity quaternions. Use exact nominal scale*(1+1e-8)+1e-8 rounded outward. The full native checker treats all numeric inputs as exact rationals.
